rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Electric potential is the same as electric potential energy.' ✅ Potential is *energy per unit charge* (J/C); potential energy is the *total energy* (J) required to assemble charges.  ·  ❌ 'Electric potential is zero where the electric field is zero.' ✅ Not always true (e.g., at the center of a charged ring, E=0 but V≠0).
